notes: No standalone production OperationStatus exists; React parity uses a test-local presentational harness.
All stages, attempts, and messages are synthetic display labels, not backend or polling claims.

labels.title: Synthetic operation
labels.message: Synthetic progress for visual review only.

geometry.layout: compact title, stage, attempt, message, and progress row
geometry.progress: bounded horizontal indicator with visible stage text

expectedTokenGeometry: Status card uses quiet border and compact metadata
Stage is communicated by text as well as progress fill

r10.keyboardTouch: not applicable to read-only operation status
r10.focus: no focus is required for static status content
r10.screenReader: named status region exposes stage and safe message
r10.reducedMotion: progress presentation has no required animation
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: active stage uses aria-live status; terminal stage remains visible
r10.darkLight: harness renders in zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
